title: Adding guests bypasses the "seats disable guests" invariant and inflates seat counts
description: New endpoint has no seatsPerTimeSlot guard, allowing attendees to create unlimited attendee rows on seated bookings. Over-capacity is then reported immediately, and new rows have no BookingSeat so guests cannot cancel.

title: Guest-email blacklist is case-sensitive, bypassing the filter
description: Blacklist is lowercased but comparison is case-sensitive, allowing uppercase variants (e.g., Spam@Evil.com) to bypass the filter and be added as attendees.

title: isTeamAdminOrOwner uses && which reduces to owner-only
description: ANDing isTeamAdmin (ADMIN or OWNER) with isTeamOwner (OWNER only) narrows the result to OWNER, contradicting the variable name and blocking team admins.

title: Server schema doesn't enforce uniqueness its error message claims
description: Uniqueness is validated only client-side. Direct tRPC calls with duplicate emails pass validation and create multiple identical attendee rows with duplicate invites.

title: you_do_not_have_permission translation key is missing
description: The error key was not added to locales/en/common.json, so unauthorized users see the raw key "you_do_not_have_permission" instead of a translated message.

title: Existing attendees get fresh scheduled invite instead of add-guests notice
description: Handler passes raw guests input instead of filtered uniqueGuests, so already-invited attendees are matched and re-sent full AttendeeScheduledEmail with REQUEST ICS instead of AttendeeAddGuestsEmail.

title: isInvalidEmail is never cleared except on Cancel
description: After a failed validation, the error flag persists after successful submission or dismissal via Esc/overlay, showing stale error state when the dialog is reopened.
